notes.title: Checkout total shows wrong amount after applying coupon code COUPON_STACK in src/components/CartSummary.tsx
content: Applying two coupons at checkout makes the cart total in `CartSummary` ignore the second coupon discount.
Tracked as task-1042; fix is in src/components/CartSummary.tsx and the order total endpoint.
notes.applicability: Customer reports that the checkout total is wrong after adding more than one coupon

notes.title: Refund endpoint POST /api/refunds returns 500 when the Stripe webhook arrives twice (missing idempotency key in src/routes/refunds.ts)
content: A duplicate Stripe webhook makes the refund endpoint throw PgError 23505 and return status 500.
Tracked as task-1077; add an idempotency key check in src/routes/refunds.ts.
notes.applicability: Refund requests fail with a 500 from the refunds endpoint

notes.title: Nightly DAG daily_revenue_rollup fails with KeyError: 'region' in dags/revenue_rollup.py
content: The nightly Airflow DAG `daily_revenue_rollup` fails because the region column is missing from the upstream CSV.
Tracked as task-2210; guard the pandas merge in dags/revenue_rollup.py.
notes.applicability: Nightly Atlas report or dashboard is stale because the daily_revenue_rollup DAG failed

notes.title: Push notifications not delivered on Android 14 after FCM token refresh in PushRegistrar.kt
content: After an FCM token refresh `PushRegistrar` keeps the stale token, so Pulse push notifications are not delivered on Android 14.
Tracked as task-3307; fix in PushRegistrar.kt.
notes.applicability: Users report that Pulse push notifications stopped arriving on Android

notes.title: FAQ: how to change the invoice address, Account > Billing > Addresses
content: Invoice addresses are edited under `Account > Billing > Addresses`.
Past invoices cannot be changed; ask support to issue a credit note and a new invoice.
notes.summary: Edit the invoice address under Account > Billing > Addresses. Past invoices cannot be changed; support issues a credit note and a new invoice.
notes.applicability: Customer asks how to change the invoice address or billing address on an order

notes.title: FAQ: export an Atlas dashboard report to CSV with the Export button
content: Use the `Export` button on the Atlas dashboard report page and choose CSV; the limit is 100000 rows.
For larger exports use the nightly csv export DAG in dags/export_csv.py.
notes.summary: Use the Export button on the dashboard report page and choose CSV (limit 100000 rows); larger exports use the nightly csv export DAG.
notes.applicability: User asks how to export a dashboard report to CSV

notes.title: Checkout button unresponsive in Safari 17 in src/components/PayButton.tsx
content: The pay button in `PayButton` ignores taps in Safari 17 because of a passive touch listener.
Reported by a customer email; not reviewed by a human.
notes.applicability: Checkout pay button does nothing in Safari
